strategy.summary: Reproduce the Quaternion.log nan defect for purely real quaternions in sympy at the buggy commit 6f1468e51e69 by running the sympy algebras quaternion test module; the developer's added test_issue_28556 (and the raises(ValueError) line in test_quaternion_functions) should fail on the buggy revision and pass on the fixed revision.

pinned_because: sympy version is unbounded in the evidence: no documented constraint and no era ceiling, so the strategy uses the checked-out buggy commit itself rather than a pinned release; the tested version is reported as sympy 1.14.0 only

strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 6f1468e51e69, test_issue_28556 fails because Quaternion(1,0,0,0).log() returns a quaternion with nan vector components instead of Quaternion(0,0,0,0), so the equality assert fails; and test_quaternion_functions fails because raises(ValueError) on q0.log() is not satisfied. On the fixed revision, both tests pass because the log of a purely real quaternion returns Quaternion(ln r,0,0,0) and the zero quaternion raises ValueError.
risks: The bug is a pure-Python 0/0 division in the vector part, so it is not platform, architecture, BLAS, threading or sanitiser dependent; no special platform is required to see the transition.

Test equality uses sympy exact symbolic comparison with no numerical tolerance, so the transition depends on exact simplification of log(1) and log(E) into 0 and 1; if simplification differs in the environment the pass case could fail for reasons unrelated to the fix.

The fix is stated in the evidence as returning Quaternion(ln(q_norm),0,0,0) when vector_norm is zero and raising ValueError for zero quaternions; if the fixed revision differs, the raises(ValueError) line in test_quaternion_functions could be the only transitioning assertion.

The dependency constraint for sympy is null and undocumented, so the exact sympy version used by the benchmark is inferred from the checked-out commit rather than a stated constraint; the reported tested version 1.14.0 is the only version evidence.
The test diff also adds a blank line within test_quaternion_functions; running the whole module is safer than the -k filter if test collection order or fixtures matter.
No pip dependency beyond pytest and sympy's own requirements (mpmath) was stated in the evidence, so mpmath is assumed to be installed by pip install -e.

oracle.reference_source: PR #28565 test assertions comparing against Quaternion(0,0,0,0) and Quaternion(log(r),0,0,0)
oracle.why: The test uses sympy exact equality per the evidence; no numerical tolerance is stated.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: On buggy commit, Quaternion(1,0,0,0).log() yields nan vector components, so the == comparison with Quaternion(0,0,0,0) is False and the assert fails; the raises(ValueError) check also fails because no ValueError is raised.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: On fixed revision, purely real input returns Quaternion(log(r),0,0,0) without dividing by zero, so exact comparisons hold and the zero quaternion raises ValueError as the raises check expects.
